evidence.message: Paper submission update. Remove tracked Data artifacts and add preprocessing notebooks and revised analysis code.
Update to IO utils and Added Forests — read/write // Import/export(swc) now parallel, and Forest class for collections of trees added
Subtrees — find and generate masks for a sub tree defined by a single vertex

interpretation.proven: The currently public PP1/PP3 preprocessing notebooks were not present when Point_data.pkl was first committed.
interpretation.unresolved: The exact December 2025 generator implementation, its exact software commit, exact morphology materialization, and execution environment remain unrecovered.
interpretation.public_toolchain_evidence: The public NeuRosetta commit that adds the Forest/SWC IO infrastructure used by the later PP2 notebook is dated 2026-01-26, after the 2025-12-09 Point_data commit. This does not exclude a private predecessor.
interpretation.legacy_boundary: A separate public legacy NeuRosetta repository already contained subtree functionality in April 2025 and .nr support earlier. Therefore the chronology rules out only the later public Forest/IO pipeline as the documented historical implementation; it does not rule out a legacy or private NeuRosetta-based generator.

execution_note: Repository chronology was independently verified through immutable GitHub commit metadata and file trees. Local container execution of the network-fetching audit could not run because outbound DNS/network access to github.com is unavailable in the analysis environment.
